summary: New Product Lines, New Collections and a Brand New Look
title: Introducing The New 2024 Bathware Catalogue - Black Book 8
bodyHtml:
Our New Definitive Collection Catalogue, Price Guide and Bathroom Inspiration Gallery.

This edition of our catalog marks a significant shift in how we present our products. Discover thoughtfully curated sets that bring together essential bathroom components—basins, toilets, baths, and in-wall cisterns.

Plus explore an expansive range of New Baths, New Matte White Collection, a swathe of brand new product lines, a return of pricing and so much more!

Download Catalogue

Or click here to request a hard copy.

A Brand New Look and Experience:
The Art of Bathware Alchemy

The story of our bathware, like landscapes of mountains and valleys, begins as elemental clay, transformed through the alchemy of water, heat, and pressure into the exquisite pieces you see in our catalog.

Our new design direction symbolizes this transformation through the simplified lines of topography, reminding us of the craftsmanship behind each piece in our collection.

What's New in this Edition?

2024 Bath Collection

Made with MarmoTech - a formulation of premium stone composite materials and 100% Silica free, each bath undergoes a meticulous process, ensuring the highest standards of quality and durability.

Explore Bath Collection

Collection Organic

Introducing the Organic Collection by Studio Bagno — a testament to minimalism and timeless design. This collection gracefully departs from intricate details, welcoming soft lines and gentle curves.

Explore Collection Organic

Collection Decus

Collection Decus is an ingenious range of bathware meticulously crafted for small bathrooms, ensuites, and powder rooms, engineered with a focus on purposeful design whilst maintaining Studio Bagno’s strict adherence to timeless aesthetics.

Explore Collection Decus

Collection Federation

Experience the beauty of the past redefined for the present. Collection Federation is a timeless range of classic-styled bathware that pays homage to the elegance of a bygone era.

Explore Collection Federation

On-Demand Matte White

Explore a curated range designed to bring the softness and tactility of a timeless finish to your bathroom with minimal wait times. No more waiting for 12-14 weeks — our Matte White Collection is in-stock and ready to ship.

Explore Collection Matte White

New Synthesis Eco Series Toilets

Our new toilet range effortlessly complements the soft square aesthetic and chamfer base of our Collection Decus, creating a harmonious blend of style and efficiency for the modern bathroom.

Explore Synthesis Eco

New Lunaris Series

Lunaris draws its design influence from the graceful dance of the moon, offering an exceptional statement piece to elevate your wash area.

Explore Lunaris

New Luxury Toilet Package and Simplified In-Wall Cistern and Flush Buttons Pricing

We've taken significant steps to enhance our competitiveness by strategically reducing prices on key products like in-wall cisterns, push plates, and toilet & cistern packages.

Learn More

Pricing is Back!

Reintroducing retail prices into our catalogue marks a return to stability and transparency within our brand.

During the turbulence of the pandemic, we temporarily removed prices to navigate manufacturing and shipping fluctuations.

Now, with a more settled landscape, reinstating prices aligns with the requests of our retailers, offering the clarity and consistency they desired.
